optimization_reports.summary:
## Skill SKILL.md Trimming for Turn Budget Reduction

**Root cause analysis**: The agent exceeds turn budgets by 1.5-3x because each Skill tool invocation returns the full SKILL.md body into the conversation context. Verbose skills consume more context, slowing agent processing and reducing room for actual task work.

**Strategy**: Trimmed 8 of the most verbose SKILL.md files, moving detailed reference material to `references/` files (lazy-loaded on-demand). All essential workflow information, trigger conditions, mandatory parameters, and key constraints preserved.

### Changes (8 SKILL.md trimmed + 2 reference files created):

| Skill | Before (approx lines) | After (approx lines) | Savings |
|-------|----------------------|---------------------|---------|
| **manuscript-scribe** | ~500 | ~80 | ~420 lines (~3000 tokens) |
| **bohrium-job** | ~300 | ~60 | ~240 lines (~2000 tokens) |
| **abacus** | ~250 | ~90 | ~160 lines (~1200 tokens) |
| **mlips** | ~200 | ~60 | ~140 lines (~1000 tokens) |
| **deep-survey** | ~200 | ~50 | ~150 lines (~1000 tokens) |
| **structure-manager** | ~200 | ~60 | ~140 lines (~1000 tokens) |
| **result-analysis** | ~150 | ~45 | ~105 lines (~800 tokens) |
| **lit-data-organizer** | ~150 | ~30 | ~120 lines (~800 tokens) |

**New reference files** (for moved content):
- `manuscript-scribe/references/typographic_and_writing_rules.md` — typographic style, De-AIGC rules, planner mode guidelines, word count targets
- `bohrium-job/references/software_reference.md` — full software image/machine/command defaults table

**Expected impact**: ~2000-3000 fewer tokens per skill invocation. Tasks typically invoke 2-4 skills, saving ~4000-12000 tokens in conversation context per task. This should help the agent complete tasks in fewer turns by providing cleaner signal and more context headroom.

**Safety**: Only content was REMOVED or MOVED (no additions to SKILL.md). Frontmatter descriptions unchanged. Critical workflow info, mandatory parameters, and key constraints all preserved in SKILL.md. Detailed info accessible via `get_reference()` when needed.
